faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the IIT Roorkee Project Officer (Clinical Psychologist) recruitment is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology or an equivalent degree with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution and hold a valid CRR.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Officer (Clinical Psychologist) post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Project Officer (Clinical Psychologist) position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Roorkee offer any age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to SC/ST candidates if they possess equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the IIT Roorkee official website, and links are provided in the Important Links section of this article.
